posts.title: HHS to assign government lawyers to migrant kids' cases
posts.excerpt: A September 29 Federal Register notice signed by Secretary Kennedy places the new Unaccompanied Alien Children Legal Representation Division inside HHS's Office of General Counsel, authorizing its…
posts.body: A September 29 Federal Register notice signed by Secretary Kennedy places the new Unaccompanied Alien Children Legal Representation Division inside HHS's Office of General Counsel, authorizing its attorneys to advise children and enter appearances in immigration court ([September 29 notice](https://111things.com/national/hhs-creates-legal-division-for-unaccompanied-migrant-children/)). Legal-aid leaders [told the Associated Press](https://www.lapost.com/content/critics-decry-trump-administration-s-move-to-assign-government-lawyers-to-migrant-kids-cases) the setup fails basic standards for independent counsel, putting the children's lawyers inside the same department that holds them in custody.

posts.title: Core training speeds sprints and lifts jumps, 49 studies show
posts.excerpt: A Frontiers in Physiology meta-analysis of 49 studies found core training raised sprint speed and jump height across sports. The verdict: treat core work as the complement to sport-specific sprint,…
posts.body: A [Frontiers in Physiology meta-analysis](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physiology/articles/10.3389/fphys.2026.1946447/full) of 49 studies found core training raised sprint speed and jump height across sports. The verdict: treat core work as the complement to sport-specific sprint, strength, and plyometric blocks, not the program itself.

posts.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel physics prize for IceCube neutrino work
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 6, 2026, 11:00 AM. The 82-year-old Belgian astrophysicist proposed the IceCube Neutrino Observatory back in 1988, betting a cubic kilometer of Antarctic ice threaded with light sensors…
posts.body: Published Oct 6, 2026, 11:00 AM. The 82-year-old Belgian astrophysicist proposed the IceCube Neutrino Observatory back in 1988, betting a cubic kilometer of Antarctic ice threaded with light sensors could trap particles that pass through planets untouched. The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences [awarded him the 2026 physics prize Tuesday](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/06/science/nobel-prize-physics-francis-halzen-winner-intl?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_meta) for the discovery of high-energy cosmic neutrinos.

posts.body: The Administration for Children and Families published a notice on October 5, 2026 proposing revisions to ORR's Mental Health Assessment Form and a consolidated Onsite Health Intervention Form, with public comments open through November 4, 2026. posts.title: Deisseroth, Hegemann and Nagel win 2026 Nobel medicine prize

posts.body: Karl Deisseroth of Stanford, Peter Hegemann of Humboldt University and Georg Nagel of the University of Würzburg won the [2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine](https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/deisseroth-hegemann-nagelwin-2026-nobel-medicine-prize-2026-10-05/) for their discoveries on light-gated ion channels and optogenetics. posts.body: Saronic announced on September 30 that the Navy had awarded it a production contract for Marauder, the 180-foot autonomous ship, [per Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/09/saronic-awarded-production-contract-for-marauder-under-u-s-navys-musv-marketplace/). The order covers 10 Marauders, with the first deliveries due before the end of fiscal year 2027, [per the same report](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/09/saronic-awarded-production-contract-for-marauder-under-u-s-navys-musv-marketplace/).

posts.title: Arrest made in 28-year-old Georgia cold case
posts.excerpt: James Lawrence III, 47, was arrested Thursday and charged with malice murder, felony murder, and aggravated assault in the 1998 stabbing death of 20-year-old Christy Dawn Myers. Forensic evidence is…
posts.body: James Lawrence III, 47, was arrested Thursday and [charged with malice murder, felony murder, and aggravated assault](https://www.savannahnow.com/story/news/crime/2026/10/02/georgia-bureau-of-investigation-makes-arrest-in-1998-cold-case/92059151007/) in the 1998 stabbing death of 20-year-old Christy Dawn Myers. Forensic evidence is what named him, in a case that had sat unsolved since Myers was found stabbed beside her car along a Coffee County highway.

posts.title: Wisconsin clinic loses funding to represent detained kids
posts.excerpt: Erin Barbato, director of the University of Wisconsin Law School's Immigrant Justice Clinic, told Wisconsin Public Radio the clinic will not receive the federal funding it expected, after two years…
posts.body: Erin Barbato, director of the University of Wisconsin Law School's Immigrant Justice Clinic, told Wisconsin Public Radio the clinic will not receive the federal funding it expected, after two years of work toward hiring a staff attorney and a paralegal for detained children under 12 in removal proceedings. [WPR, via MigraPrep](https://migraprep.com/en/news/wisconsin-detained-children-legal-funding-cut-2026-10-02/), tied the expected money to the $810 million in congressionally approved spending the White House moved to withhold on September 25, a "pocket rescission" that GAO's standing position says can violate federal law without Congress's approval, with MigraPrep stressing the loss is potential and no case yet shown decided.

posts.title: GitHub ships code-defined dynamic workflows for Copilot
posts.excerpt: GitHub's October 1 changelog shipped code-defined dynamic workflows for Copilot in public preview across the CLI, the app, and the SDK, per Pondero's write-up. A workflow is a program, written in…
posts.body: GitHub's October 1 changelog shipped code-defined dynamic workflows for Copilot in public preview across the CLI, the app, and the SDK, [per Pondero's write-up](https://pondero.ai/news/2026-10-04-copilot-dynamic-workflows/). A workflow is a program, written in code, that mixes automated steps with agent judgment calls and pauses at checkpoints for a human to resume, [per the same write-up](https://pondero.ai/news/2026-10-04-copilot-dynamic-workflows/).

posts.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark PCs launch in October with local AI agents
posts.excerpt: NVIDIA's RTX Spark Windows PCs arrive this month from Lenovo and Acer, built to run AI agents on the desk instead of in the cloud, per BitcoinVersus.Tech. The trick is up to 128GB of unified memory…
posts.body: NVIDIA's RTX Spark Windows PCs arrive this month from Lenovo and Acer, built to run AI agents on the desk instead of in the cloud, [per BitcoinVersus.Tech](https://bitcoinversus.tech/2026/10/04/semiconductors-nvidia-rtx-spark-october-local-ai-windows/). The trick is up to 128GB of unified memory shared between its Grace CPU and Blackwell GPU, so large local models stop fighting a small VRAM budget, [per the same report](https://bitcoinversus.tech/2026/10/04/semiconductors-nvidia-rtx-spark-october-local-ai-windows/).

posts.title: Russian drone hits Kyiv bridge as Germany's chancellor arrives
posts.excerpt: A Russian drone struck Kyiv's Northern Bridge on Sunday morning as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in the city, injuring two people. Berlin is expected to release €1 billion in military aid.
posts.body: A Russian drone [struck Kyiv's Northern Bridge on Sunday morning](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/04/europe/russian-drone-kyiv-merz-ukraine?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_meta) as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in the city, injuring two people. Berlin is expected to release €1 billion in military aid.

posts.title: Dallas police arrest suspect in 30-year-old cold case
posts.excerpt: Dallas police arrested Gary Len Ross, 56, on Friday and charged him with capital murder in the 1993 killing of Tommie Davis, who was found beaten and slashed inside her Haskell Avenue home on May 18,…
posts.body: Dallas police arrested Gary Len Ross, 56, on Friday and charged him with capital murder in the 1993 killing of Tommie Davis, who was found beaten and slashed inside her Haskell Avenue home on May 18, 1993, [per FOX 4's reporting](https://fox4news.com/news/dallas-police-make-arrest-30-year-old-cold-case). The break came from blood on a wall of Davis's home that was not hers: a CODIS match returned the name Tommy Lynn Jones, which investigators determined was Ross's alias.
